title: Optional rest and wake contract
description: Define when rest is allowed, refused, interrupted, or advances ordinary turns.
close_reason: Release 1228 adds one reachable Bedroom and parser-valid SLEEP, REST, NAP, DOZE, LIE DOWN, and no-object WAKE routes while preserving original WAIT/Z and actor-waking behavior. Full sleep is Bedroom-only and refuses active clothing fire, tied legs, or a hostile actor in the room.

title: Timer advancement and exploit prevention
description: Preserve canonical queues and prevent skipping danger or farming events.
close_reason: Full sleep advances the canonical CLOCKER one step at a time and stops on the first live clock event or authored warning. An unchanged evidence signature produces only a one-turn shallow doze, preventing bulk timer skipping, repeated recovery, and event farming.

title: Bounded nonterminal recovery
description: Recover selected temporary states without erasing permanent consequences.
close_reason: A completed rest with newly earned evidence may improve one negative temporary strength step and clear transient stagger or lingering garlic scent. It cannot resurrect the player, restore lost objects, reset actors or mechanisms, solve puzzles, open routes, or erase permanent history.
